title: EYCE PV1 Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
Load, close, and pull.

Introducing the first vaporizer device from Eyce, the PV1 is an exceptional, easy-to-use dry herb vape engineered with incredible durability and portability. Designed with a rotating mouthpiece, a glass-coated alumina ceramic heat chamber, and a stainless-steel airflow path, the PV1 delivers a smooth vapor. Featuring AutoFlow™ vape technology, the PV1 has four preset temperature settings that gradually increase the temperature over a 5-minute time period for optimal impact.

AutoFlow™ Temperature Settings:
Blue (Low) 350-370 F
Green 370-390 F
Yellow 390-410 F
Red (High) 410-430 F

PV1 Features:
Dry herb portable vaporizer
Stainless steel airflow path
Glass-coated alumina ceramic heat chamber
Rotating mouthpiece
Stealth mode LED
AutoFlow™ vape tech
Food grade 304 steel
Silicone lid
USB-C charging
